steps.why: rustc links through cc, which the package installs.
Cargo runs a crate, its compiler and cc brought with it.

steps.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/amy-crate/src && cd /tmp/amy-crate && printf '[package]
name = "amy-crate"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
' > Cargo.toml && printf 'fn main() { println!("{}", 6 * 7); }
' > src/main.rs && test "$(cargo run --offline --quiet)" = 42
cd /tmp && printf 'syntax = "proto3";\nmessage Probe { string name = 1; }\n' > amy.proto && protox amy.proto -o amy.pb && test -s amy.pb
printf '#[no_mangle]\npub extern "C" fn answer() -> i32 { 42 }\n' > /tmp/amy-answer.rs && cbindgen /tmp/amy-answer.rs | grep -q 'int32_t answer'
